provision-2025.title: State of Grocery Delivery 2025
provision-2025.text: State of Grocery Delivery 2025. Provision Retail Analytics surveyed 4,200 online grocery shoppers across North America in Q1 2025. Item substitution quality consistently ranks among the top three drivers of customer dissatisfaction in online grocery. 41% of online grocery shoppers said poor item substitutions led them to reduce their order frequency over the past year. Shoppers who experienced repeated poor substitutions reported lower satisfaction scores and reduced reorder intent. Retailers that introduced customer-controlled substitution preferences saw measurable gains in repeat purchase rates, though the report cautions that results varied widely by category and region. Delivery timing and produce freshness were the other two leading dissatisfaction drivers.

instafresh-help-2025.title: Substitution preferences
instafresh-help-2025.text: Substitution preferences. Customers can pre-approve a preferred substitute for any item before checkout. If an item is unavailable, your shopper will use your pre-approved substitute, or refund the item if you selected 'Do not substitute'. You can change these preferences for each item in your cart.

grocerydive-2025.title: Grocery delivery logistics brief
grocerydive-2025.text: Grocery delivery logistics brief, 2025. Last-mile delivery windows continue to tighten as retailers compete on speed. Dense urban routes average 22 stops per driver shift. Cold-chain handling for frozen and dairy remains the leading operational complaint from drivers.

grocerly-blog-2025.title: How Grocerly handles out-of-stock items
grocerly-blog-2025.text: How Grocerly handles out-of-stock items. When an item is unavailable, Grocerly shows the shopper up to three suggested substitutes ranked by how often other customers accepted them. Customers can turn substitutions off entirely for any item. Since launching per-item substitution controls, Grocerly reports fewer post-delivery refund requests, without publishing a specific figure.
